input: Exposure to toxic content is a risk associated with A video platform's image analysis system is designed to automatically review and filter thumbnail images, aiming to prevent the display of inappropriate or offensive content. The system uses AI to detect and remove violating images, ensuring a safe and respectful user experience. It also seeks to identify and prevent attempts to manipulate viewer engagement through misleading or explicit thumbnails.
